content: Dii bar wimaisulid-ular, Bab-Jehová Jeremíasʼga sunmaknonikid. Ega weyob sognonikid:

content.text: Yalagi dii bar wisulidbali, napamar daas-daas naded.
Dule-sapurgi-arbamaladi akusunna na itogusmalad, bukib binsagusmalad.
Moli-sapur-uayasuid, yar-mullugan-swiligangi achu-sapur-uaya-gannagannayob, masbina asa-nakwa-nakwa gudidamalad.
¿Ar ibiga degite, be we-yalagi dule-baidyobi bakar-nadapi be gusunna?
Emide be, igi dule-aineba-danikid ibagwen-wis-gabis-naddaedyob be gued.
¿Ar ibiga be dule-bilagi-urwed gege-dule-bendakedyob be dasunna?
bela dulemar wisid, anmar begadga gued.
Emisgindi, aka be, bemar-isguedgi-binsaega be an-imakarmalad,

content: Geb Bab-Jehová weyob anga sokalid: “Jeremías, melle we-dulemar-bendakega be anse wilesakwaa golo.

Ar anse-goled-ular, mas-gunsuli-gumalale, amba an itogosulid. Ar amba anga ibmar-ogumakar-ukmalale, anga ibmar-gwagmar-ukmalale, amba an abingaosulid. Es-suidgi an we-dulemar obelogoed, degi, ukudgi, boni-dummagangi an we-dulemar obelogoed.”

Bab-Jehová-abin an sogded: “¡Bab-Dummad-Jehová! ¡Nunmaked-dummaddo! Ar Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsogedye-sogdimaladi, sunmakdimalad, we-dulemarde es-suidgi burgosurmarye, ukud-dummad-naguosurye sogmalad. Unnila, bede, we-yalagi ega neg-bogidikid-degisadeguad-ukoye sogdimalad.”

Geb Bab-Jehová an-abin sogded: “Wedi, gayaburba-barsogmalad an-nuggi gakansaar sunmakdimalad. Gwen an we-dulemar barmissulid, gwen an ega an-nuggi-sunmakega igar uksasurbalid, gwen an ega sunmakdisulid. We-dulemar-sunmakmaladi, unnila binsa yogasaar na wargwen-ibya-apuredba sunmakdimalad, binsa ee gordimalad, dukin-yogasaar-e-itogedba sunmakmalad.”

A-ulale, weyob Bab-Jehová soged: “We-dulemar an gwen-barmissulidi, an-nuggi sunmakmarye-sogmaladi, degine, na sogmarbalidi, we-yalagi dulemar es-suidgi burgosurye, ukud-dummad naguosurye. Ar wemala, na ukudba burgwemaloed, e-sunnagwad es-suidgi burgwemaloed.

”Degine, dule-we-sunmakmalad-itosmaladi, Jerusalén-neggwebur-neg-imbabali ukudba mellemamai gumaloed, es-suidgi oburgwilemaloed, igarba-mellemamai gumaloed. E-omegan-e-muimar, e-masmala-e-muimar, e-bunamala-e-muimar gwen dule digosurmalad. Ar dule-muimar-digedbela sate gumaloed. Ar bela e-isgumalad egi aibinega an imakoed.

content.text: Sapurba an nadele, es-suidgi-dulemar-burgwisad-e-mui omilede an dakdaed.
Neggweburgi an dogdele, ukudba-dulemar-burgwisad-e-mui omilede an dakdaed.
Ar Bab-gayaburba-barsogmaladdi, degi, dule-irwa-Babse-gormaladbela, neg-gunaid akudakmalad.’ ”
Bab-Jehová, anmar, anmar-isgusad magar na itoged.
Be-nug be nue-sabedbali, melle be isdar anmar-dake.
Bab-Dummad, ¿ar bab-dummagan-imbagi, gwensak dii-nabir-owied gudisi? Suli.
Ar bela be we-ibmarmar imaksad. A-ulale, anmar begi bensurmalad.”
